title: Design a Library Management System
description: Model books, catalog search, members, checkout, and return with fines.

data.text: Design a library with books, members, checkout/return, and overdue fines. Books have ISBN, title, author. Members can borrow up to 5 books for 14 days.

data.title: Book, Member, and LibraryService
Why Dictionary for books?
data.text: ISBN is globally unique, so Dictionary<string, Book> gives O(1) lookup by ISBN. For search-by-title, iterate values with LINQ. For large libraries, add a separate search index.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: ISBN is the natural unique key for books
Member tracks borrowed books for limit enforcement
DueDate on Book makes overdue detection trivial
Fine is calculated at return time, not checkout
data.takeaway: A simple library system needs books, members, and a service that enforces borrowing rules and calculates fines on return.
